core_compatibility: ==0.2.0 plus exact source hashes in dependency-identity.json

capabilities.name: get_policy
capabilities.authorization: read-only fixed policy; no model-selected path
capabilities.deprecation: frozen trial only; incompatible future contract requires explicit new version

evidence.unknown_usage: explicit marker plus retained reservation; not measured consumption
evidence.content_policy: synthetic content in this trial-agent folder only; no keys, headers, raw SDK errors or hidden reasoning

invocation: CLI one JSON input file or await readiness.invoke(input_value,transport=...,campaign_dir=...)
return: One strict JSON envelope; CLI exit0 on success,2 on terminal failure
orchestrator_note: Not orchestrator-verified. Trusted caller must respect immutable campaign state, external semantic stop and explicit live authority. No subagents supported.
circuit_breaker: stop on first failed case; no retry/fallback
idempotency: No automatic resubmission; unique invocation ID; campaign preserves failed attempts; local policy read is idempotent.
